title: First American Celebrates a Decade as One of the Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance™, According to Great Place to Work® and Fortune

body_markdown:
---


October 6, 2026, Santa Ana, Calif.


[First American Financial Corporation](http://www.firstam.com/) **(NYSE:**[FAF](http://www.firstam.com/investor) **),** a premier provider of title, settlement and risk solutions for real estate transactions and the leader in the digital transformation of its industry, announced today that Great Place to Work® and *Fortune* have recognized First American as one of the Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance™ for the tenth consecutive year.


"Earning this recognition for 10 straight years is a reflection of the outstanding people who work at First American," said Mark Seaton, CEO of First American Financial Corporation. "Our people show up for one another, for our customers and for the communities we serve, and they do it with the commitment, teamwork and integrity that define our culture. This honor belongs to them, and I'm proud to celebrate this decade of recognition together."


The Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance list is highly competitive. Great Place to Work, the global authority on workplace culture, determines the list based on analysis of confidential survey responses from more than 194,000 employees at Great Place to Work-Certified™ companies in the financial services and insurance industry. Honorees were selected based on their ability to offer positive outcomes for employees regardless of job role, work status, or other demographic identifier.


“Congratulations to the Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance,” said Michael C. Bush, CEO of Great Place to Work. “People are the heart of work in every industry, and finance is no exception. These companies show how delivering for your people drives financial performance and turns fear of future into the confidence to win.”


### **Additional Workplace Culture Recognition**


Earlier this year, First American was named one of the[100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine](https://investors.firstam.com/investors/news-and-events/news/press-release-details/2026/First-American-Marks-11-Years-as-One-of-the-Fortune-100-Best-Companies-to-Work-For/default.aspx) for the eleventh consecutive year. In 2025, First American marked a decade as one of the[Fortune Best Workplaces for Women™](https://www.firstam.com/news/2025/faf-decade-best-workplaces-women-20251023.html) and was recognized as one of the 2025[PEOPLE® Companies that Care](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.greatplacetowork.com/companies-that-care__;!!L1aKtqoz4WY!c3XctCams2oWK8LAhA3eWGKpG561s3rCC0MUhIiDwcCWHbXNQp4aqQ6SIGmdHagr2ABqHHCa3KUo7z7ex0Wuv2Fw$) . The company was also named one of the[Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents™](https://www.firstam.com/news/2025/faf-2025-fortune-best-workplaces-for-parents-20251118.html) and a[2026 Military Friendly® Employer](https://www.firstam.com/news/2025/faf-2026-military-friendly-employer-20251111.html) .


The company’s Canadian subsidiary, FCT, has been named by Great Place to Work to the “Best Workplaces™ in Canada – 1000+ Employees” list for the past 12 years. First American’s Indian subsidiary, FAI, was recognized among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces for the first time in 2026 and was also named among India’s Top 100 Best Workplaces for Women (large companies).


### **About First American**


**First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF)** is a premier provider of title, settlement, and risk solutions for real estate transactions. With its combination of financial strength and stability built over more than 135 years, innovative proprietary technologies, and unmatched data assets, the company is leading the digital transformation of its industry. First American also provides data products to the title industry and other third parties; valuation products and services; mortgage subservicing; home warranty products; banking, trust and wealth management services; and other related products and services. With total revenue of $7.5 billion in 2025, the company offers its products and services directly and through its agents throughout the United States and abroad. In 2026, First American was named one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For by Great Place to Work® and Fortune Magazine for the eleventh consecutive year. More information about the company can be found at[www.firstam.com](https://www.firstam.com/) . ****
